title: Connect your Chrome
intro: With the UClone-X extension, clones open their tabs in your own Chrome, in a "UClone-X" tab group, signed in where you are. Chrome shows a bar on every tab a clone uses; close it to take the tab back.
loadFailed: The browser connection could not be read.
connected: Connected. Clones open their tabs in your Chrome.
connectedVersion: Connected. Clones open their tabs in your Chrome (extension {version}).
notConnected: Not connected. Until you connect, clones browse in a separate Chrome window that UClone-X opens.
stepExtensions: In Chrome, open chrome://extensions and turn on "Developer mode".
stepLoad: Press "Load unpacked" and choose this folder:
stepPaste: Click the UClone-X extension, paste this pairing code, and press "Connect":
copyFailed: Could not copy. Select the text and copy it yourself.
newCodeHelp: The current code stops working, and a connected Chrome is disconnected until it gets the new one.
newCodeFailed: A new pairing code could not be made. Check that UClone-X is running and try again.

signIns.title: Saved sign-ins
signIns.intro: When a page asks a clone to sign in, the clone signs in with the one saved here for that site. They stay on this computer, in UClone-X's settings file.
signIns.loadFailed: Saved sign-ins could not be read.
signIns.none: No sign-ins are saved. Until you add one, a clone that meets a sign-in page asks you to sign in yourself.
signIns.deleteFailed: The sign-in could not be deleted. Check that UClone-X is running and try again.
signIns.passwordKeep: Leave blank to keep the saved password
signIns.keyHelp: The key the site shows beside its QR code when you turn on two-step sign-in. Leave it blank if the site asks for no code.
signIns.keyKeep: Leave blank to keep the saved 2FA key
signIns.saved: Saved. The password is not shown again.

refused.site_missing: Enter the site, such as shop.example.com.
refused.username_missing: Enter the username or email you sign in with.
refused.password_missing: Enter the password. A new sign-in needs one.
refused.setup_key_invalid: That 2FA setup key could not be read. Copy it again from the site: it is letters A–Z and digits 2–7.
refused.settings_unreadable: UClone-X's settings file could not be read, so nothing was saved. Check that the file is in place and try again.
refused.other: The sign-in could not be saved. Check that UClone-X is running and try again.

sessions.title: Signed-in sites
sessions.intro: Sites the clones have visited since UClone-X started that are still signed in. Signing out ends that site's sign-in in the browser; a saved sign-in stays saved.
sessions.loadFailed: Signed-in sites could not be read.
sessions.closed: No browser is open, so there are no signed-in sites to show.
sessions.none: The browser is open, and no site the clones visited since UClone-X started is signed in.
sessions.signOutFailed: Could not sign out. Check that UClone-X is running and try again.
